Package org.springframework.http.codec

@NullMarked package org.springframework.http.codec
Provides implementations of Encoder and Decoder for web use.

还声明了用于读取和写入 HTTP 请求与响应主体的高级别 HttpMessageReader 和 HttpMessageWriter。
